## GradientText.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `gradient` :: The fill: the theme accent, an aurora of hue offsets, a warmer sunset, or a monochrome fade.
- `animated` :: Sweeps the gradient slowly along the text.
- `children` :: The text the gradient fills.
